When to Hire an Energy Consultant

Our tools are great for understanding your bill and finding quick wins. However, you should consider hiring a certified energy consultant if:

  • Your facility uses over 100,000 kWh per month.
  • You are planning a major renovation or equipment upgrade.
  • You want to install solar panels or battery storage.
